conbody.p: When Lane Following Assist is not working properly, the Master warning light () appears on the instrument cluster, along with a warning message that lasts for several seconds.

If the warning message and Master warning light appear on the instrument cluster, have the Lane Following Assist inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: You can check the Lane Following Assist warning message in the utility information view of the instrument cluster display window.
